records.name: Russia–Ukraine war
records.summary: 64,439 deaths in 2,808 recorded events so far this year; 16,981 in the last three months. Last recorded event 2026-09-30.
records.background: Russia annexed Crimea and backed separatists in the Donbas in 2014, then launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022. After Ukraine pushed Russian forces back from Kyiv, Kharkiv and Kherson in 2022, the front settled into attritional fighting in the east and south, with long-range drone and missile strikes on cities and energy infrastructure on both sides.

records.name: Iran: war with Israel and the US, and state repression
records.summary: 23,848 deaths in 538 recorded events so far this year; 147 in the last three months. Last recorded event 2026-09-30.
records.background: Iran and Israel fought a long proxy conflict through allied groups in Lebanon, Syria, Iraq and Yemen. In 2024 they exchanged direct missile strikes, and in June 2025 Israel and the United States struck Iranian nuclear and military sites in a twelve-day war. UCDP also records lethal violence by the Iranian government against civilians, including protesters.
conflicts: Iran - Israel, United States of America

records.name: Nigeria and the Lake Chad basin
records.summary: 6,061 deaths in 1,111 recorded events so far this year; 1,797 in the last three months. Last recorded event 2026-09-30.
records.background: Boko Haram (JAS) began its insurgency in north-east Nigeria in 2009; its rival Islamic State West Africa Province now dominates the Lake Chad area. North-west Nigeria suffers mass kidnappings and killings by armed "bandit" gangs, and the Middle Belt sees recurring farmer–herder violence.

records.name: Israel–Palestine and Lebanon
records.summary: 5,748 deaths in 1,175 recorded events so far this year; 493 in the last three months. Last recorded event 2026-09-30.
records.background: Hamas attacked southern Israel on 7 October 2023, and Israel responded with a war in Gaza that caused mass casualties and destruction. Hezbollah opened a second front from Lebanon; Israel escalated against it in 2024, including a ground incursion into southern Lebanon, before a ceasefire that both sides accused each other of breaking.

records.name: Yemen
records.summary: 5,018 deaths in 510 recorded events so far this year; 4,640 in the last three months. Last recorded event 2026-09-30.
records.background: The Houthi movement seized Sanaa in 2014, and a Saudi-led coalition intervened in 2015 for the internationally recognised government. A 2022 truce largely held inside Yemen, but the Houthis attacked Red Sea shipping and Israel from late 2023, drawing US, UK and Israeli strikes. Southern separatists and government-aligned forces also clash with each other.
conflicts: Forces of the Presidential Leadership Council - ASTC

records.name: Pakistan and Afghanistan
records.summary: 4,325 deaths in 1,024 recorded events so far this year; 1,949 in the last three months. Last recorded event 2026-09-30.
records.background: The Pakistani Taliban (TTP) stepped up attacks after the Afghan Taliban returned to power in 2021, and Pakistan accuses Kabul of sheltering it. Baloch separatists wage a separate insurgency in Balochistan. Pakistan has struck targets inside Afghanistan, leading to border clashes between the two states.

records.name: Central Sahel insurgencies
records.summary: 4,264 deaths in 1,130 recorded events so far this year; 1,014 in the last three months. Last recorded event 2026-09-30.
records.background: Jihadist groups linked to al-Qaeda (JNIM) and the Islamic State have spread across Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger since 2012. Military juntas took power in all three countries between 2020 and 2023, expelled French forces and turned to Russian mercenaries, while attacks on soldiers, militias and civilians intensified.
conflicts: Government of Mali, Government of Russia (Soviet Union) - Civilians

records.name: Sudanese civil war
records.summary: 4,051 deaths in 437 recorded events so far this year; 721 in the last three months. Last recorded event 2026-09-28.
records.background: Fighting broke out in April 2023 between Sudan's army and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces, former allies in the 2021 coup. The war has displaced millions and produced famine, with mass killings in Darfur. The army retook Khartoum in 2025 while the RSF consolidated its hold on Darfur and parts of Kordofan.

records.name: Ethiopia: Amhara and Oromia insurgencies
records.summary: 3,260 deaths in 651 recorded events so far this year; 1,090 in the last three months. Last recorded event 2026-09-30.
records.background: After the 2020–22 Tigray war ended in a peace deal, fighting moved to Amhara, where Fano militias rebelled in 2023 against the federal government, and continued in Oromia with the Oromo Liberation Army.

records.name: Somalia: al-Shabaab insurgency
records.summary: 2,915 deaths in 274 recorded events so far this year; 646 in the last three months. Last recorded event 2026-09-28.
records.background: Al-Shabaab, an al-Qaeda affiliate, has fought Somalia's federal government and African Union forces since the late 2000s. Government offensives from 2022 regained territory, but the group retained rural strongholds in the centre and south and continued bombings in Mogadishu.

records.name: Mexico: cartel wars
records.summary: 2,147 deaths in 1,728 recorded events so far this year; 696 in the last three months. Last recorded event 2026-09-30.
records.background: Mexico's drug war has run since 2006. From 2024 a split inside the Sinaloa Cartel between the "Chapitos" and "Mayos" factions made Sinaloa a major battleground, while the Jalisco New Generation Cartel fights rivals across several states.
conflicts: Jalisco Cartel New Generation, Sinaloa Cartel - Los Chapitos - Sinaloa Cartel - Los Mayos
Jalisco Cartel New Generation - Santa Rosa de Lima Cartel
Jalisco Cartel New Generation - Sinaloa Cartel

records.name: Islamic State attacks on civilians (worldwide)
records.summary: 1,552 deaths in 232 recorded events so far this year; 349 in the last three months. Last recorded event 2026-09-30.
records.background: UCDP records Islamic State attacks on civilians as one conflict across every country where its branches operate, from West Africa and the Sahel to Mozambique, Syria, Afghanistan and the Philippines.

records.name: Eastern DR Congo
records.summary: 1,498 deaths in 296 recorded events so far this year; 287 in the last three months. Last recorded event 2026-09-29.
records.background: The Rwanda-backed M23 rebellion resurfaced in 2022 and, under the AFC alliance, captured Goma and Bukavu in early 2025. Dozens of other armed groups, including the Islamic State-linked ADF, operate in Ituri and the Kivus.

records.name: Colombia and Venezuela
records.summary: 1,427 deaths in 962 recorded events so far this year; 692 in the last three months. Last recorded event 2026-09-30.
records.background: Despite the 2016 FARC peace deal, the ELN, FARC dissident factions and the Clan del Golfo fight the state and each other over drug and mining economies, including across the Venezuelan border.

records.name: Myanmar civil war
records.summary: 1,414 deaths in 420 recorded events so far this year; 388 in the last three months. Last recorded event 2026-09-30.
records.background: The military seized power in February 2021. Armed resistance by pro-democracy forces and ethnic armed organisations grew into a nationwide civil war; a 2023 rebel offensive took large areas along the borders, and the junta relies heavily on air strikes.

records.name: Syria
records.summary: 527 deaths in 349 recorded events so far this year; 163 in the last three months. Last recorded event 2026-09-30.
records.background: Rebels led by Hayat Tahrir al-Sham toppled Bashar al-Assad in December 2024. The new government faces sectarian violence on the coast and in the south, Islamic State remnants, and unresolved disputes with the Kurdish-led authorities in the north-east.

records.name: South Sudan
records.summary: 520 deaths in 27 recorded events so far this year; 173 in the last three months. Last recorded event 2026-09-04.
records.background: The 2018 peace deal that ended South Sudan's civil war frayed in 2025 after the arrest of First Vice-President Riek Machar, with renewed clashes between the army and opposition-aligned forces.

records.name: Haiti: gang war
records.summary: 490 deaths in 77 recorded events so far this year; 162 in the last three months. Last recorded event 2026-09-27.
records.background: Gang coalitions, chiefly Viv Ansanm, control most of Port-au-Prince and have expanded into the Artibonite. A Kenyan-led multinational security mission arrived in 2024 with limited effect.
